class Row(string id, real64[] values, string label, real64 target, bool target_present)

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] result := []
    for line := text.split(NL)[]
        if line != ""
            result = result.append(line)
    return result

int[] integers(string[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(int(value))
    return result

real64[] reals(string[] values)
    real64[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(real64(value))
    return result

class Settings(local string[][] fields)
    string[] scalings := fields[0][1:<#fields[0]]
    int[] ks := integers(fields[1][1:<#fields[1]])
    string[] metrics := fields[2][1:<#fields[2]]
    string[] weightings := fields[3][1:<#fields[3]]
    folds := int(fields[4][1])
    edit_k := int(fields[5][1])
    int[] curve := integers(fields[6][1:<#fields[6]])
    real64[] bins := reals(fields[7][1:<#fields[7]])
    top := int(fields[8][1])

Settings read_settings()
    string[][] fields := []
    for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        fields = fields.append(line.split(" "))
    return Settings(fields)

class Rows(string[] features, Row[] entries)

Rows read_rows(string name)
    lines := read_lines("input/" + name)
    header := lines[0].split(",")
    Row[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[index].split(",")
        count := int(#fields)
        present := fields[count - 1] != ""
        real64 target := if present then real64(fields[count - 1]) else 0.0
        result = result.append(Row(fields[0], reals(fields[1:<count - 2]), fields[count - 2], target, present))
    return Rows(header[1:<#header - 2], result)

class Dataset(string[] features, Row[] train, Row[] test_rows, Settings settings)

Dataset read_dataset()
    training := read_rows("train.csv")
    testing := read_rows("test.csv")
    return Dataset(training.features, training.entries, testing.entries, read_settings())

int lookup(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return -1

int row_index(Row[] rows, string id)
    for: index < #rows
        if rows[index].id == id
            return int(index)
    return -1

Row[] id_order(Row[] rows)
    string[] ids := []
    for row := rows[]
        ids = ids.append(row.id)
    Row[] result := []
    for id := ids.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(rows[row_index(rows, id)])
    return result

import collections
import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import scale = "./scaling.qui"
import neighbors = "./neighbors.qui"
import validation = "./validation.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int[] consecutive(int first, int last)
    int[] result := []
    for: first <= value < last
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

dataset.Row[] take_rows(dataset.Row[] rows, int[] indices)
    dataset.Row[] result := []
    for index := indices[]
        result = result.append(rows[index])
    return result

string[] labels_of(dataset.Row[] rows)
    string[] values := []
    for row := rows[]
        values = values.append(row.label)
    string[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or value != result[-1]
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

class CrossValidation(validation.Model model, local dataset.Row[] rows, validation.Prediction[] predictions)
    bool[] hits := []
    correct := 0
    local real64[] errors := []
    for: index < #rows
        hit := predictions[index].label == rows[index].label
        hits = hits.append(hit)
        if hit
            correct += 1
        errors = errors.append(predictions[index].estimate - rows[index].target)
    real64 rmse_value := validation.rmse(errors)

class ModelSpace(string method, string metric)

validation.Prediction | error prediction_value(map<string, validation.Prediction> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        validation.Prediction found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing prediction {key}")

CrossValidation[] cross_validate(validation.Model[] models, dataset.Row[] rows, int fold_count, int[] features)
    map<string, validation.Prediction>[] predictions := []
    ModelSpace[] spaces := []
    for model := models[]
        map<string, validation.Prediction> pending
        predictions = predictions.append(pending)
        known := false
        for space := spaces[]
            known = known or (space.method == model.scaling and space.metric == model.metric)
        if not known
            spaces = spaces.append(ModelSpace(model.scaling, model.metric))
    for fold := validation.stratified_folds(rows, fold_count)[]
        training := validation.fold_training(rows, fold)
        queries := take_rows(rows, fold)
        for space := spaces[]
            orders := validation.neighbor_orders(training, queries, space.method, space.metric, features)
            for: number < #models
                model := models[number]
                if model.scaling == space.method and model.metric == space.metric
                    for: position < #fold
                        predicted := validation.prediction_from_order(orders[position], model.k, model.weighting)
                        .predictions[number].set(rows[fold[position]].id, predicted)
    CrossValidation[] result := []
    for: number < #models
        validation.Prediction[] ordered := []
        for row := rows[]
            ordered = ordered.append(prediction_value(predictions[number], row.id))
        result = result.append(CrossValidation(models[number], rows, ordered))
    return result

CrossValidation best_classifier(CrossValidation[] results)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#results)
        if results[index].correct > results[best].correct
            best = index
    return results[best]

CrossValidation best_regressor(CrossValidation[] results)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#results)
        if report.four_decimal(results[index].rmse_value) < report.four_decimal(results[best].rmse_value)
            best = index
    return results[best]

int correct_count(validation.Prediction[] predictions, dataset.Row[] rows)
    result := 0
    for: index < #rows
        if predictions[index].label == rows[index].label
            result += 1
    return result

real64[] residuals(validation.Prediction[] predictions, dataset.Row[] rows)
    real64[] result := []
    for: index < #rows
        result = result.append(predictions[index].estimate - rows[index].target)
    return result

string label_counts(dataset.Row[] rows, string[] labels)
    string[] result := []
    for label := labels[]
        count := 0
        for row := rows[]
            if row.label == label
                count += 1
        result = result.append("{label} {count}")
    return result.join(" ")

string[] evaluation_lines(dataset.Row[] rows, validation.Prediction[] predictions, string[] labels)
    int[][] matrix := []
    for: index < #labels
        matrix = matrix.append(array(#labels, fill = 0))
    for: index < #rows
        for: actual < #labels
            if rows[index].label == labels[actual]
                for: predicted < #labels
                    if predictions[index].label == labels[predicted]
                        matrix[actual][predicted] += 1
    lines := ["true\predicted " + labels.join(" ")]
    for: index < #labels
        string[] counts := []
        for count := matrix[index][]
            counts = counts.append(string(count))
        lines = lines.append(labels[index] + " " + counts.join(" "))
    real64[] totals := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    valued := [0, 0, 0]
    for: index < #labels
        hits := matrix[index][index]
        predicted := 0
        actual := 0
        for: other < #labels
            predicted += matrix[other][index]
            actual += matrix[index][other]
        numerators := [hits, hits, 2 * hits]
        denominators := [predicted, actual, predicted + actual]
        for: metric < 3
            if denominators[metric] > 0
                totals[metric] += real64(numerators[metric]) / real64(denominators[metric])
                valued[metric] += 1
        lines = lines.append("class {labels[index]} precision {report.fraction(hits, predicted)} recall {report.fraction(hits, actual)} f1 {report.fraction(2 * hits, predicted + actual)} support {actual}")
    string[] averages := []
    for: metric < 3
        averages = averages.append(if valued[metric] == 0 then "-" else report.fixed(totals[metric] / real64(valued[metric])))
    return lines.append("macro precision {averages[0]} recall {averages[1]} f1 {averages[2]}")

string[] reliability_lines(dataset.Row[] rows, validation.Prediction[] predictions, real64[] bounds)
    real64[] lower := [0.0]
    lower = lower.concat(bounds)
    counts := array(#lower, fill = 0)
    hits := counts
    real64[] shares := array(#lower, fill = 0.0)
    for: index < #rows
        bin_index := 0
        for bound := bounds[]
            if bound <= predictions[index].share
                bin_index += 1
        counts[bin_index] += 1
        if predictions[index].label == rows[index].label
            hits[bin_index] += 1
        shares[bin_index] += predictions[index].share
    string[] lines := []
    for: index < #lower
        line := "bin {report.fixed(lower[index], 2)} rows {counts[index]}"
        if counts[index] > 0
            line += " correct {report.ratio(hits[index], counts[index])} share {report.fixed(shares[index] / real64(counts[index]))}"
        lines = lines.append(line)
    return lines

validation.Model[] build_grid(dataset.Settings settings)
    validation.Model[] result := []
    for k := settings.ks[]
        for metric := settings.metrics[]
            for weighting := settings.weightings[]
                for method := settings.scalings[]
                    result = result.append(validation.Model(k, metric, weighting, method))
    return result

real64[] real_values(map<string, real64[]> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        real64[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

class ClassifierSpace(validation.Model model, dataset.Row[] training, local dataset.Row[] testing)
    local features := consecutive(0, int(#training[0].values))
    local parameters := scale.compute(training, model.scaling)
    local real64[][] vectors := []
    positions := map<string, int>()
    for: index < #training
        vectors = vectors.append(parameters.transform(training[index].values, features))
        .positions.set(training[index].id, int(index))
    gaps := map<string, real64[]>()
    for query := training.concat(testing)[]
        vector := parameters.transform(query.values, features)
        real64[] distances := []
        for reference := vectors[]
            distances = distances.append(neighbors.distance(vector, reference, model.metric))
        .gaps.set(query.id, distances)

    neighbors.Neighbor[] order(dataset.Row query, dataset.Row[] rows)
        distances := real_values(gaps, query.id)
        neighbors.Neighbor[] result := []
        for row := rows[]
            result = result.append(neighbors.Neighbor(distances[dataset.lookup(positions, row.id)], row))
        return neighbors.sorted_neighbors(result)

    neighbors.Vote voting(dataset.Row query, dataset.Row[] rows, int k)
        neighbors.Neighbor[] ordered := order(query, rows)
        return neighbors.vote(ordered[0:<math.min(k, int(#ordered))], model.weighting)

    string nearest_label(dataset.Row query, dataset.Row[] rows)
        return order(query, rows)[0].row.label

class Removal(dataset.Row row, neighbors.Vote ballot)

class Editing(dataset.Row[] rows, Removal[][] passes)

Editing wilson_editing(ClassifierSpace space, dataset.Row[] rows, int edit_k)
    current := rows
    Removal[][] passes := []
    while true
        Removal[] removed := []
        for row := current[]
            dataset.Row[] others := []
            for other := current[]
                if other.id != row.id
                    others = others.append(other)
            ballot := space.voting(row, others, edit_k)
            if ballot.label != row.label
                removed = removed.append(Removal(row, ballot))
        passes = passes.append(removed)
        if #removed == 0
            return Editing(current, passes)
        dataset.Row[] retained := []
        for row := current[]
            found := false
            for removal := removed[]
                found = found or removal.row.id == row.id
            if not found
                retained = retained.append(row)
        current = retained

class Condensing(dataset.Row[] rows, int scans)

Condensing hart_condensing(ClassifierSpace space, dataset.Row[] rows)
    stored := [rows[0]]
    scans := 0
    while true
        scans += 1
        added := false
        for row := rows[]
            if dataset.row_index(stored, row.id) < 0 and space.nearest_label(row, stored) != row.label
                stored = stored.append(row)
                added = true
        if not added
            return Condensing(dataset.id_order(stored), scans)

class Experiment(dataset.Dataset data)
    string[] feature_names := data.features
    features := consecutive(0, int(#feature_names))
    dataset.Row[] train := data.train
    dataset.Row[] test_rows := data.test_rows
    dataset.Settings settings := data.settings
    labels := labels_of(train)
    dataset.Row[] labelled := []
    dataset.Row[] targeted := []
    for: index < #test_rows
        if test_rows[index].label != ""
            labelled = labelled.append(test_rows[index])
        if test_rows[index].target_present
            targeted = targeted.append(test_rows[index])
    grid := build_grid(settings)
    int[][] folds := validation.stratified_folds(train, settings.folds)
    CrossValidation[] results := cross_validate(grid, train, settings.folds, features)
    classifier := best_classifier(results)
    regressor := best_regressor(results)
    validation.Prediction[] test_predictions := validation.predict_rows(classifier.model, train, test_rows, features)
    local validation.Prediction[] regression := validation.predict_rows(regressor.model, train, test_rows, features)
    real64[] test_estimates := []
    validation.Prediction[] labelled_predictions := []
    for: index < #test_rows
        test_estimates = test_estimates.append(regression[index].estimate)
        if test_rows[index].label != ""
            labelled_predictions = labelled_predictions.append(test_predictions[index])

    string names(int[] selected)
        string[] result := []
        for feature := selected[]
            result = result.append(feature_names[feature])
        return result.join(" ")

    string train_ratio(int count)
        return report.ratio(count, int(#train))

    string classifier_summary(CrossValidation result)
        return "{result.model.notation()} correct {train_ratio(result.correct)} rmse {report.fixed(result.rmse_value)}"

    string regressor_summary(CrossValidation result)
        return "{result.model.notation()} rmse {report.fixed(result.rmse_value)} correct {train_ratio(result.correct)}"

    string[] grid_table()
        lines := ["k,metric,weighting,scaling,correct,accuracy,rmse"]
        for result := results[]
            model := result.model
            lines = lines.append("{model.k},{model.metric},{model.weighting},{model.scaling},{result.correct},{report.fixed(real64(result.correct) / real64(#train))},{report.fixed(result.rmse_value)}")
        return lines

    string[] prediction_table()
        lines := ["id,label,vote_share,estimate"]
        for: index < #test_rows
            predicted := test_predictions[index]
            lines = lines.append("{test_rows[index].id},{predicted.label},{report.fixed(predicted.share)},{report.fixed(test_estimates[index])}")
        return lines

    string[] data_part()
        return ["data train {#train} test {#test_rows} labelled {#labelled} targets {#targeted} features {#features} classes {#labels}", "classes " + label_counts(train, labels)]

    string[] scaling_part(string method)
        parameters := scale.compute(train, method)
        lines := ["scaling {method}"]
        for: index < #feature_names
            lines = lines.append("{feature_names[index]} center {report.fixed(parameters.centers[index], 6)} scale {report.fixed(parameters.scales[index], 6)}")
        return lines

    string[] folds_part()
        lines := ["folds {settings.folds}"]
        for: index < #folds
            lines = lines.append("fold {index + 1} size {#folds[index]} {label_counts(take_rows(train, folds[index]), labels)}")
        return lines

    string[] selection_part()
        return ["grid {#grid}", "best_classifier " + classifier_summary(classifier), "best_regressor " + regressor_summary(regressor)]

    string[] top_part(bool accuracy)
        order := consecutive(0, int(#results))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#order)
            chosen := order[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0
                previous := results[order[cursor - 1]]
                entry := results[chosen]
                earlier := if accuracy then entry.correct > previous.correct else report.four_decimal(entry.rmse_value) < report.four_decimal(previous.rmse_value)
                if not earlier
                    break
                order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            order[cursor] = chosen
        kind := if accuracy then "accuracy" else "rmse"
        lines := ["top {settings.top} by {kind}"]
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
            result := results[order[rank]]
            string details := if accuracy then classifier_summary(result) else regressor_summary(result)
            lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {details}")
        return lines

    string[][] best_per_item_parts()
        string[][] parts := []
        items := ["k", "metric", "weighting", "scaling"]
        string[] k_values := []
        for value := settings.ks[]
            k_values = k_values.append(string(value))
        values := [k_values, settings.metrics, settings.weightings, settings.scalings]
        for: position < 4
            item := items[position]
            lines := ["best per {item}"]
            for value := values[position][]
                CrossValidation[] chosen := []
                for result := results[]
                    model := result.model
                    entry := if position == 0 then string(model.k) elif position == 1 then model.metric elif position == 2 then model.weighting else model.scaling
                    if entry == value
                        chosen = chosen.append(result)
                first := best_classifier(chosen)
                second := best_regressor(chosen)
                lines = lines.append("{item}={value} classifier {first.model.notation()} accuracy {report.fixed(real64(first.correct) / real64(#train))} regressor {second.model.notation()} rmse {report.fixed(second.rmse_value)}")
            parts = parts.append(lines)
        return parts

    string[] classifier_folds_part()
        lines := ["classifier folds"]
        for: index < #folds
            count := 0
            for row := folds[index][]
                if classifier.hits[row]
                    count += 1
            lines = lines.append("fold {index + 1} correct {report.ratio(count, int(#folds[index]))}")
        return lines

    string[] regressor_folds_part()
        lines := ["regressor folds"]
        for: index < #folds
            real64[] errors := []
            for row := folds[index][]
                errors = errors.append(regressor.predictions[row].estimate - train[row].target)
            lines = lines.append("fold {index + 1} size {#folds[index]} rmse {report.fixed(validation.rmse(errors))}")
        return lines

    string[] mcnemar_part()
        lines := ["mcnemar"]
        for metric := settings.metrics[]
            CrossValidation[] selected := []
            for result := results[]
                if result.model.metric == metric
                    selected = selected.append(result)
            comparison := best_classifier(selected)
            only_selected := 0
            only_comparison := 0
            for: index < #train
                if classifier.hits[index] and not comparison.hits[index]
                    only_selected += 1
                elif comparison.hits[index] and not classifier.hits[index]
                    only_comparison += 1
            difference := math.max(0, math.abs(only_selected - only_comparison) - 1)
            numerator := difference * difference
            denominator := only_selected + only_comparison
            statistic := if denominator == 0 then "0/1 0.0000" else report.fraction(numerator, denominator)
            significant := if 1000 * numerator > 3841 * denominator then "yes" else "no"
            lines = lines.append("{comparison.model.notation()} b {only_selected} c {only_comparison} statistic {statistic} significant {significant}")
        return lines

    string[][] leave_one_out_parts()
        model := classifier.model
        validation.Prediction[][] by_k := []
        for: index < #settings.ks
            by_k = by_k.append([])
        real64[] estimates := []
        for: index < #train
            row := train[index]
            others := validation.fold_training(train, [int(index)])
            orders := validation.neighbor_orders(others, [row], model.scaling, model.metric, features)
            for: choice < #settings.ks
                by_k[choice] = by_k[choice].append(validation.prediction_from_order(orders[0], settings.ks[choice], model.weighting))
            validation.Prediction[] predicted := validation.predict_rows(regressor.model, others, [row], features)
            estimates = estimates.append(predicted[0].estimate)
        model_index := 0
        for: index < #settings.ks
            if settings.ks[index] == model.k
                model_index = int(index)
        predictions := by_k[model_index]
        dataset.Row[] errors := []
        for: index < #train
            if predictions[index].label != train[index].label
                errors = errors.append(train[index])
        string[] class_errors := []
        for label := labels[]
            count := 0
            for row := errors[]
                if row.label == label
                    count += 1
            class_errors = class_errors.append("{label} {count}")
        counts := class_errors.join(" ")
        first := ["leave_one_out classifier {model.notation()}", "errors {train_ratio(int(#errors))}", "class_errors {counts}"]
        for row := dataset.id_order(errors)[]
            predicted := predictions[dataset.row_index(train, row.id)]
            first = first.append("{row.id} true {row.label} predicted {predicted.label} share {report.fixed(predicted.share)}")
        real64[] differences := []
        for: index < #train
            differences = differences.append(estimates[index] - train[index].target)
        second := ["leave_one_out regressor {regressor.model.notation()}", "rmse {report.fixed(validation.rmse(differences))} mae {report.fixed(validation.mae(differences))}", "largest {settings.top} residuals"]
        order := consecutive(0, int(#train))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#order)
            chosen := order[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0
                previous := order[cursor - 1]
                left := report.four_decimal(math.abs(differences[chosen]))
                right := report.four_decimal(math.abs(differences[previous]))
                if left < right or (left == right and collections.lex_compare(train[chosen].id.codepoints(), train[previous].id.codepoints()) >= 0)
                    break
                order[cursor] = previous
                cursor -= 1
            order[cursor] = chosen
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
            index := order[rank]
            second = second.append("{train[index].id} target {report.fixed(train[index].target)} estimate {report.fixed(estimates[index])} residual {report.fixed(differences[index])}")
        third := ["leave_one_out by k metric={model.metric} weighting={model.weighting} scaling={model.scaling}"]
        for: index < #settings.ks
            predicted := by_k[index]
            third = third.append("k={settings.ks[index]} correct {train_ratio(correct_count(predicted, train))} rmse {report.fixed(validation.rmse(residuals(predicted, train)))}")
        return [first, second, third]

    string[] nested_part()
        lines := ["nested_cross_validation folds {settings.folds}"]
        real64[] estimates := array(#train, fill = 0.0)
        total_correct := 0
        for: number < #folds
            fold := folds[number]
            training := validation.fold_training(train, fold)
            queries := take_rows(train, fold)
            inner_results := cross_validate(grid, training, settings.folds, features)
            first := best_classifier(inner_results)
            second := best_regressor(inner_results)
            validation.Prediction[] predicted_labels := validation.predict_rows(first.model, training, queries, features)
            correct := correct_count(predicted_labels, queries)
            total_correct += correct
            validation.Prediction[] predicted_values := validation.predict_rows(second.model, training, queries, features)
            for: index < #fold
                estimates[fold[index]] = predicted_values[index].estimate
            lines = lines.append("fold {number + 1} classifier {first.model.notation()} inner {report.fixed(real64(first.correct) / real64(#training))} outer {report.ratio(correct, int(#fold))}")
            lines = lines.append("fold {number + 1} regressor {second.model.notation()} inner {report.fixed(second.rmse_value)} outer {report.fixed(validation.rmse(residuals(predicted_values, queries)))}")
        real64[] errors := []
        for: index < #train
            errors = errors.append(estimates[index] - train[index].target)
        return lines.append("nested accuracy {train_ratio(total_correct)} rmse {report.fixed(validation.rmse(errors))}")

    string[] feature_selection_part()
        model := classifier.model
        current := features
        selected := current
        selected_correct := classifier.correct
        lines := ["feature_selection {model.notation()}", "start features {names(current)} correct {train_ratio(classifier.correct)}"]
        step := 0
        while #current >= 3
            step += 1
            int[] candidate_counts := []
            chosen := 0
            for: index < #current
                int[] remaining := []
                for feature := current[]
                    if feature != current[index]
                        remaining = remaining.append(feature)
                candidate := cross_validate([model], train, settings.folds, remaining)
                candidate_counts = candidate_counts.append(candidate[0].correct)
                if candidate[0].correct > candidate_counts[chosen]
                    chosen = int(index)
            string[] details := []
            for: index < #current
                details = details.append("{feature_names[current[index]]} {candidate_counts[index]}")
            removed := current[chosen]
            correct := candidate_counts[chosen]
            current = current[0:<chosen].concat(current[chosen + 1:<#current])
            listing := details.join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("step {step} remove {feature_names[removed]} correct {train_ratio(correct)} candidates {listing}")
            if correct >= selected_correct
                selected = current
                selected_correct = correct
        validation.Prediction[] predicted := validation.predict_rows(model, train, labelled, selected)
        lines = lines.append("selected features {names(selected)} correct {train_ratio(selected_correct)}")
        return lines.append("selected test {report.ratio(correct_count(predicted, labelled), int(#labelled))}")

    string[] test_classification_part()
        correct := correct_count(labelled_predictions, labelled)
        lines := ["test classification {classifier.model.notation()}", "labelled {#labelled} correct {report.ratio(correct, int(#labelled))}"]
        return lines.concat(evaluation_lines(labelled, labelled_predictions, labels))

    string[] uncertain_part()
        real64[] margins := []
        for predicted := test_predictions[]
            margins = margins.append(predicted.share - predicted.runner_share)
        order := consecutive(0, int(#test_rows))
        for: 1 <= index < int(#order)
            chosen := order[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and report.four_decimal(margins[chosen]) < report.four_decimal(margins[order[cursor - 1]])
                order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            order[cursor] = chosen
        lines := ["uncertain {settings.top} test rows"]
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
            index := order[rank]
            row := test_rows[index]
            predicted := test_predictions[index]
            runner := if predicted.runner == "" then "-" else predicted.runner
            truth := if row.label == "" then "-" else row.label
            lines = lines.append("{row.id} predicted {predicted.label} share {report.fixed(predicted.share)} runner_up {runner} share {report.fixed(predicted.runner_share)} margin {report.fixed(margins[index])} true {truth}")
        return lines

    string[] test_regression_part()
        real64[] errors := []
        real64[] targets := []
        for: index < #test_rows
            if test_rows[index].target_present
                errors = errors.append(test_estimates[index] - test_rows[index].target)
                targets = targets.append(test_rows[index].target)
        lines := ["test regression {regressor.model.notation()}", "targets {#errors} rmse {report.fixed(validation.rmse(errors))} mae {report.fixed(validation.mae(errors))} r2 {report.fixed(validation.r_squared(errors, targets))}"]
        for label := labels[]
            real64[] selected := []
            for: index < #test_rows
                if test_rows[index].target_present and test_rows[index].label == label
                    selected = selected.append(test_estimates[index] - test_rows[index].target)
            value := if #selected == 0 then "-" else report.fixed(validation.rmse(selected))
            lines = lines.append("class {label} targets {#selected} rmse {value}")
        return lines

    string[] misclassified_part()
        lines := ["misclassified test rows"]
        count := 0
        for: index < #labelled
            row := labelled[index]
            predicted := labelled_predictions[index]
            if predicted.label != row.label
                count += 1
                lines = lines.append("{row.id} true {row.label} predicted {predicted.label} share {report.fixed(predicted.share)}")
                for neighbor := predicted.nearest[]
                    lines = lines.append("  {neighbor.row.id} {neighbor.row.label} {report.fixed(neighbor.gap)}")
        return lines.append("count {count}")

    string[] metrics_report()
        string[][] parts := [data_part()]
        for method := settings.scalings[]
            parts = parts.append(scaling_part(method))
        parts = parts.concat([folds_part(), selection_part(), top_part(true), top_part(false)])
        parts = parts.concat(best_per_item_parts())
        parts = parts.append(classifier_folds_part())
        parts = parts.append(regressor_folds_part())
        parts = parts.append(["cross_validation classes"].concat(evaluation_lines(train, classifier.predictions, labels)))
        parts = parts.append(["cross_validation reliability"].concat(reliability_lines(train, classifier.predictions, settings.bins)))
        parts = parts.append(mcnemar_part())
        parts = parts.concat(leave_one_out_parts())
        parts = parts.concat([nested_part(), feature_selection_part(), test_classification_part()])
        parts = parts.append(["test reliability"].concat(reliability_lines(labelled, labelled_predictions, settings.bins)))
        parts = parts.concat([uncertain_part(), test_regression_part(), misclassified_part()])
        return report.join_parts(parts)

    string[] learning_curve_table()
        lines := ["n,train_size,correct,accuracy,rmse"]
        for limit := settings.curve[]
            taken := array(#labels, fill = 0)
            dataset.Row[] rows := []
            for row := train[]
                for: index < #labels
                    if row.label == labels[index] and taken[index] < limit
                        taken[index] += 1
                        rows = rows.append(row)
            validation.Prediction[] predicted_labels := validation.predict_rows(classifier.model, rows, labelled, features)
            correct := correct_count(predicted_labels, labelled)
            validation.Prediction[] predicted_values := validation.predict_rows(regressor.model, rows, targeted, features)
            lines = lines.append("{limit},{#rows},{correct},{report.fixed(real64(correct) / real64(#labelled))},{report.fixed(validation.rmse(residuals(predicted_values, targeted)))}")
        return lines

    string[] prototype_line(ClassifierSpace space, string name, dataset.Row[] rows)
        knn_correct := 0
        nearest_correct := 0
        for row := labelled[]
            if space.voting(row, rows, classifier.model.k).label == row.label
                knn_correct += 1
            if space.nearest_label(row, rows) == row.label
                nearest_correct += 1
        return ["set {name} size {#rows} {label_counts(rows, labels)} knn {report.ratio(knn_correct, int(#labelled))} 1nn {report.ratio(nearest_correct, int(#labelled))}"]

    string[] id_lines(dataset.Row[] rows)
        string[] lines := []
        for: start < int(#rows) step 10
            string[] ids := []
            for: start <= index < math.min(start + 10, int(#rows))
                ids = ids.append(rows[index].id)
            lines = lines.append(ids.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] borders_part(ClassifierSpace space, dataset.Row[] ordered)
        lines := ["borders"]
        total := 0
        for label := labels[]
            count := 0
            members := 0
            real64 same_total := 0.0
            real64 other_total := 0.0
            for row := ordered[]
                if row.label != label
                    continue
                members += 1
                dataset.Row[] others := []
                for other := ordered[]
                    if other.id != row.id
                        others = others.append(other)
                order := space.order(row, others)
                if order[0].row.label != label
                    count += 1
                same_found := false
                other_found := false
                for neighbor := order[]
                    if neighbor.row.label == label and not same_found
                        same_total += neighbor.gap
                        same_found = true
                    if neighbor.row.label != label and not other_found
                        other_total += neighbor.gap
                        other_found = true
            total += count
            lines = lines.append("class {label} size {members} border {count} same {report.fixed(same_total / real64(members))} other {report.fixed(other_total / real64(members))}")
        return lines.append("border total {train_ratio(total)}")

    string[] hubs_part()
        occurrences := array(#train, fill = 0)
        for predicted := test_predictions[]
            for neighbor := predicted.nearest[]
                occurrences[dataset.row_index(train, neighbor.row.id)] += 1
        dataset.Row[] ordered := dataset.id_order(train)
        int[] order := []
        anti_hubs := 0
        for row := ordered[]
            index := dataset.row_index(train, row.id)
            order = order.append(index)
            if occurrences[index] == 0
                anti_hubs += 1
        for: 1 <= position < int(#order)
            chosen := order[position]
            cursor := position
            while cursor > 0 and occurrences[chosen] > occurrences[order[cursor - 1]]
                order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            order[cursor] = chosen
        lines := ["hubs k={classifier.model.k} queries {#test_rows}"]
        for: rank < math.min(settings.top, int(#order))
            index := order[rank]
            lines = lines.append("{train[index].id} {train[index].label} {occurrences[index]}")
        return lines.append("anti_hubs {anti_hubs}")

    string[] prototypes_report()
        space := ClassifierSpace(classifier.model, train, test_rows)
        dataset.Row[] ordered := dataset.id_order(train)
        editing := wilson_editing(space, ordered, settings.edit_k)
        original := hart_condensing(space, ordered)
        edited := hart_condensing(space, editing.rows)
        editing_lines := ["editing k={settings.edit_k}"]
        for: index < #editing.passes
            removed := editing.passes[index]
            editing_lines = editing_lines.append("pass {index + 1} removed {#removed}")
            for removal := removed[]
                editing_lines = editing_lines.append("  {removal.row.id} true {removal.row.label} predicted {removal.ballot.label} share {report.fixed(removal.ballot.share)}")
        editing_lines = editing_lines.append("edited size {#editing.rows} removed {int(#train) - int(#editing.rows)}")
        condensing := ["condensing original scans {original.scans} size {#original.rows}", "condensing edited scans {edited.scans} size {#edited.rows}"]
        string[] sets := prototype_line(space, "original", ordered).concat(prototype_line(space, "edited", editing.rows)).concat(prototype_line(space, "condensed", original.rows)).concat(prototype_line(space, "edited_condensed", edited.rows))
        string[][] parts := [["space {classifier.model.notation()}"], editing_lines, condensing, sets, ["prototypes condensed"].concat(id_lines(original.rows)), ["prototypes edited_condensed"].concat(id_lines(edited.rows)), borders_part(space, ordered), hubs_part()]
        return report.join_parts(parts)

    void write_reports()
        report.write_lines("cv_grid.csv", grid_table())
        report.write_lines("predictions.csv", prediction_table())
        report.write_lines("metrics.txt", metrics_report())
        report.write_lines("learning_curve.csv", learning_curve_table())
        report.write_lines("prototypes.txt", prototypes_report())

if main
    data := dataset.read_dataset()
    experiment := Experiment(data)
    experiment.write_reports()

import collections
import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

class Neighbor(real64 gap, dataset.Row row)

class Vote(string label, real64 share, string runner, real64 runner_share)

class Tally(string label)
    count := 0
    real64 distance_sum := 0.0
    real64 weight_sum := 0.0

real64 distance(real64[] first, real64[] second, string metric)
    real64 total := 0.0
    real64 dot := 0.0
    real64 first_squares := 0.0
    real64 second_squares := 0.0
    for: index < #first
        left := first[index]
        right := second[index]
        difference := left - right
        if metric == "squared_euclidean"
            total += difference * difference
        elif metric == "manhattan"
            total += math.abs(difference)
        elif metric == "chebyshev"
            total = math.max(total, math.abs(difference))
        else
            dot += left * right
            first_squares += left * left
            second_squares += right * right
    if metric != "cosine"
        return total
    first_norm := math.sqrt(first_squares)
    second_norm := math.sqrt(second_squares)
    return if first_norm == 0.0 or second_norm == 0.0 then 1.0 else 1.0 - dot / (first_norm * second_norm)

bool before(Neighbor first, Neighbor second)
    return if first.gap != second.gap then first.gap < second.gap else collections.lex_compare(first.row.id.codepoints(), second.row.id.codepoints()) < 0

Neighbor[] sorted_neighbors(Neighbor[] values)
    if #values < 2
        return values
    middle := #values / 2
    left := sorted_neighbors(values[0:<middle])
    right := sorted_neighbors(values[middle:<#values])
    Neighbor[] result := []
    nat first := 0
    nat second := 0
    while first < #left and second < #right
        if before(right[second], left[first])
            result = result.append(right[second])
            second += 1
        else
            result = result.append(left[first])
            first += 1
    return result.concat(left[first:<#left]).concat(right[second:<#right])

Neighbor[] neighbor_order(real64[] query, real64[][] vectors, dataset.Row[] rows, string metric)
    Neighbor[] result := []
    for: index < #rows
        result = result.append(Neighbor(distance(query, vectors[index], metric), rows[index]))
    return sorted_neighbors(result)

bool tally_before(Tally first, Tally second, string weighting)
    if weighting == "uniform" and first.count != second.count
        return first.count > second.count
    if weighting == "distance" and first.weight_sum != second.weight_sum
        return first.weight_sum > second.weight_sum
    return if first.distance_sum != second.distance_sum then first.distance_sum < second.distance_sum else collections.lex_compare(first.label.codepoints(), second.label.codepoints()) < 0

Vote vote(Neighbor[] nearest, string weighting)
    Tally[] tallies := []
    real64 total_weight := 0.0
    for neighbor := nearest[]
        selected := -1
        for: index < #tallies
            if tallies[index].label == neighbor.row.label
                selected = int(index)
                break
        if selected < 0
            selected = int(#tallies)
            tallies = tallies.append(Tally(neighbor.row.label))
        weight := 1.0 / (neighbor.gap + 0.000000001)
        tallies[selected].count += 1
        tallies[selected].distance_sum += neighbor.gap
        tallies[selected].weight_sum += weight
        total_weight += weight
    for: 1 <= index < int(#tallies)
        entry := tallies[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0 and tally_before(entry, tallies[cursor - 1], weighting)
            tallies[cursor] = tallies[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        tallies[cursor] = entry
    share := if weighting == "uniform" then real64(tallies[0].count) / real64(#nearest) else tallies[0].weight_sum / total_weight
    runner := ""
    real64 runner_share := 0.0
    if #tallies > 1
        runner = tallies[1].label
        runner_share = if weighting == "uniform" then real64(tallies[1].count) / real64(#nearest) else tallies[1].weight_sum / total_weight
    return Vote(tallies[0].label, share, runner, runner_share)

real64 estimate(Neighbor[] nearest, string weighting)
    real64 total := 0.0
    real64 weights := 0.0
    for neighbor := nearest[]
        if weighting == "uniform"
            total += neighbor.row.target
        else
            weight := 1.0 / (neighbor.gap + 0.000000001)
            total += weight * neighbor.row.target
            weights += weight
    real64 denominator := if weighting == "uniform" then real64(#nearest) else weights
    return total / denominator

string fixed(real64 value, places := 4)
    text := if places == 6 then "{value:.6}" elif places == 2 then "{value:.2}" else "{value:.4}"
    if text == "-0.000000" or text == "-0.0000" or text == "-0.00"
        return text[1:<#text]
    return text

real64 four_decimal(real64 value)
    result := real64(fixed(value))
    return result

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    return "{numerator}/{denominator} {fixed(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))}"

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "- -"
    first := numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return "{numerator / first}/{denominator / first} {fixed(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))}"

string[] join_parts(string[][] parts)
    string[] result := []
    for: index < #parts
        if index > 0
            result = result.append("")
        result = result.concat(parts[index])
    return result

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    if not file.is_directory("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

class Scaling(real64[] centers, real64[] scales)
    real64[] transform(real64[] values, int[] features)
        real64[] result := []
        for feature := features[]
            value := if scales[feature] > 0.0 then (values[feature] - centers[feature]) / scales[feature] else 0.0
            result = result.append(value)
        return result

Scaling compute(dataset.Row[] rows, string method)
    real64[] centers := []
    real64[] scales := []
    for: feature < #rows[0].values
        low := rows[0].values[feature]
        high := low
        real64 total := 0.0
        for row := rows[]
            value := row.values[feature]
            low = math.min(low, value)
            high = math.max(high, value)
            total += value
        if method == "minmax"
            centers = centers.append(low)
            scales = scales.append(high - low)
        else
            center := total / real64(#rows)
            real64 squares := 0.0
            for row := rows[]
                difference := row.values[feature] - center
                squares += difference * difference
            centers = centers.append(center)
            scales = scales.append(if #rows == 1 then 0.0 else math.sqrt(squares / real64(int(#rows) - 1)))
    return Scaling(centers, scales)

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import scale = "./scaling.qui"
import neighbors = "./neighbors.qui"

class Model(int k, string metric, string weighting, string scaling)
    string notation()
        return "k={k} metric={metric} weighting={weighting} scaling={scaling}"

class Prediction(neighbors.Neighbor[] nearest, local string weighting)
    local result := neighbors.vote(nearest, weighting)
    string label := result.label
    real64 share := result.share
    string runner := result.runner
    real64 runner_share := result.runner_share
    real64 estimate := neighbors.estimate(nearest, weighting)

int[][] stratified_folds(dataset.Row[] rows, int count)
    string[] keys := []
    map<string, int> indices
    for: index < #rows
        key := rows[index].label + "+" + rows[index].id
        keys = keys.append(key)
        .indices.set(key, int(index))
    int[][] result := []
    for: fold_index < count
        result = result.append([])
    position := 0
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        fold := position % count
        result[fold] = result[fold].append(dataset.lookup(indices, key))
        position += 1
    for: index < #result
        result[index] = result[index].sorted()
    return result

bool has_number(int[] values, int wanted)
    for value := values[]
        if value == wanted
            return true
    return false

dataset.Row[] fold_training(dataset.Row[] rows, int[] fold)
    dataset.Row[] result := []
    for: index < #rows
        if not has_number(fold, int(index))
            result = result.append(rows[index])
    return result

neighbors.Neighbor[][] neighbor_orders(dataset.Row[] training, dataset.Row[] queries, string method, string metric, int[] features)
    parameters := scale.compute(training, method)
    real64[][] vectors := []
    for row := training[]
        vectors = vectors.append(parameters.transform(row.values, features))
    neighbors.Neighbor[][] result := []
    for query := queries[]
        result = result.append(neighbors.neighbor_order(parameters.transform(query.values, features), vectors, training, metric))
    return result

Prediction prediction_from_order(neighbors.Neighbor[] order, int k, string weighting)
    count := math.min(k, int(#order))
    return Prediction(order[0:<count], weighting)

Prediction[] predict_rows(Model model, dataset.Row[] training, dataset.Row[] queries, int[] features)
    Prediction[] result := []
    for order := neighbor_orders(training, queries, model.scaling, model.metric, features)[]
        result = result.append(prediction_from_order(order, model.k, model.weighting))
    return result

real64 rmse(real64[] errors)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := errors[]
        total += value * value
    return math.sqrt(total / real64(#errors))

real64 mae(real64[] errors)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := errors[]
        total += math.abs(value)
    return total / real64(#errors)

real64 r_squared(real64[] errors, real64[] targets)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for target := targets[]
        total += target
    mean := total / real64(#targets)
    real64 residual := 0.0
    for value := errors[]
        residual += value * value
    real64 spread := 0.0
    for target := targets[]
        difference := target - mean
        spread += difference * difference
    return 1.0 - residual / spread
